notes.title: Early release released earlier
notes.notes:
Since we didn't plan on doing major changes to the actual version until the release day, we decided to release it today. Why waiting? You can now enjoy the fun of running through giant mazes and test you geometrical memory skills. Try not to loose you mind and have fun!

Cheers everyone.

notes.title: Early release soon
notes.notes: Hi everyone! Since Mazania will soon be in early release, we will take this opportunity to share our excitement with all of you. We have been working on the game for some time to make it smooth, fast and as functionnal as possible, some tweeking are done every day so when it's out, make sure updates are properly done every times. As we speak, bugs and glitches are gone a long time ago, so we hope you can enjoy it as we do. Until then, cheers.
